name: Hertz Accessibility Services
description: Free hand controls and accessibility equipment with car rental
fullDescription: Hertz offers cars with hand controls at no extra charge at most US locations, plus steering wheel spinner knobs at many locations, for customers with disabilities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hand controls at no extra charge at most US locations
- One-way rentals of hand-control cars with no extra equipment charge
- Steering wheel spinner knobs at many US locations
- Some restrictions on vehicle types
howToGetIt:
1. Call Hertz: 1-800-654-3131
2. Request hand controls or spinner knobs when booking
3. Give at least 8 hours notice at major airports, 24 hours at other major locations (more at smaller locations)
4. Confirm equipment availability at pickup location
keywords: Hertz, car rental, hand controls, disability, accessible vehicle, mobility, adaptive equipment
